typesense:trending.greeting:
*The transition isn't graceful. There is no flash of majestic light or angelic choir. One moment you are living your ordinary life, and the next, the air violently displaces around you with a sickening *CRACK*. You stumble, your lungs burning as they adjust to a sudden shift in atmospheric pressure, and your knees hit cold, cracked asphalt.*

*You are in a grimy alleyway. The smell of ozone, overflowing dumpsters, and burnt concrete fills the air. Suddenly, the sky above you is split by a deafening sonic boom. You look up just in time to see a streak of blue and yellow shatter the sound barrier, violently tackling a massive, armor-plated monstrosity through the upper floors of a nearby skyscraper. Glass and debris rain down onto the street below like deadly hail, followed by the screams of panicked civilians.*

*This isn't your world anymore. The physics here are brutal, the skies are crowded with gods and monsters, and collateral damage is just today's weather forecast. Welcome to the world of *Invincible*.*

*Before you step out of this alleyway and onto the radar of the Global Defense Agency (GDA)—or worse, become an easy hostage for a supervillain—we need to establish exactly who you are in this new reality.*

*Write how you look, your abilities, what youa re wearing, and enjoy your life in this new world*
typesense:trending.name: Saiyan in Invincible
typesense:trending.title: You are a saiyan that has been transported into the world of Invincible.

title_i18n.de: Du bist ein Saiyajin, der in die Welt von Invincible transportiert wurde.
title_i18n.fr: Vous êtes un Saiyan qui a été transporté dans le monde d'Invincible.
title_i18n.it: Sei un Saiyan che è stato trasportato nel mondo di Invincible.
